name: Sports Aviation Federation of Australia
attribution: Source: Sports Aviation Federation of Australia
uses: Club and school directories (names, state, website, the contact SAFA publishes for each, related association), upcoming events (title, dates, place, organiser, link) and the titles and dates of defect and safety notices. Never committee members' names or details, and never descriptions
method: Reading its public directory pages, each club's SAFA page and its public events feed (about 45 requests a week)

name: New Zealand Hang Gliding & Paragliding Association
attribution: Source: New Zealand Hang Gliding & Paragliding Association
uses: New Zealand club and school lists (names, regions, websites) and national-body facts
method: Provided list for now; reading public web pages later

name: Australian National Site Guide
attribution: Site facts: Australian National Site Guide
uses: Site and launch names, launch positions, short fields (type, height, wind directions, rating), the contact listed for each site, open or closed status, and each site's page address. Never descriptions, hazards, rules or landing notes
method: Their public Google Earth files of open and closed sites (2 downloads), compared with last week's copy
notes: The webmaster replied on 2026-10-12: happy for us to use the data, the Google Earth files are fine (and cached, so may be checked more often), and suggested its export service with version checks (docs/10 D59).

name: ParaglidingEarth
attribution: Community site data: © ParaglidingEarth contributors (CC BY-SA 3.0 / ODbL 1.0)
uses: Australian sites missing from the Site Guide (a separate community layer), and coordinates and wind directions for the New Zealand sample sites. Name, takeoff position, directions rated "good", and whether it suits paragliders or hang gliders. Never descriptions
method: Its open data service, one download per country (2 a month); the service needs no sign-up
notes: Share-alike licence; our copy of this data stays public in the project repository (docs/10 C17).

name: State and regional associations
uses: School and club lists, for cross-checking

name: Club websites
uses: From each club or association website listed by its national body, news and event headlines with their dates and links (from its news feed or events calendar), and which sites its own "sites" page names (to confirm who manages a site). Never article text, descriptions or photos
method: Reading each club's home page, its news feed or calendar, and its sites page (about 3 to 6 requests per club). Facebook pages are never read. A club can opt out through its robots.txt or by asking us

name: Organisations' own websites
uses: Published facts about schools, tandem operators and shops (for example a published course price), each with its page address and the date checked

name: New Zealand club site guides
uses: Links only

name: HighSide flight park
uses: Link to the flight park and its passes

name: Natural Earth
uses: State and region boundaries, used offline to work out which state or region each launch is in
method: One-off download (public domain), stored in the project

name: Compiled by Catavento
uses: Facts we gathered by hand from a public source, each with its source link (for example the New Zealand sample sites)

name: Where To Fly
uses: Nothing collected; links to its forecasts for each site

name: Open-Meteo
uses: Hourly forecast wind, fetched by your own browser when you open a page (free non-commercial tier)
method: Fetched live by the visitor's browser
schedule: Each time a page is opened

name: Windy
uses: Their standard embedded live wind map, unmodified and with their logo, shown only when you tap to load it; nothing collected
method: Embedded map from windy.com, loaded by your browser
schedule: Live, each time you load it
notes: Embedding follows Windy's public widget terms; a request for written confirmation was drafted on 2026-10-12 for the founder to send.

name: FreeFlightWx
uses: Nothing collected; links to each station's live page

name: Holfuy
uses: Nothing collected (their terms forbid it); links to each station's live page

name: Club-run weather stations
uses: Links to each station's live page

name: WeatherLink
uses: Links to each station's public page

name: Bureau of Meteorology
uses: Nothing yet; state observation feeds noted for Iteration 2, pending a check of their terms

name: XContest
uses: Links only (terms for showing flight data not yet checked)

name: SkySight
uses: Links only

name: Paragliding Map
uses: Links only

name: Retailer and manufacturer websites
uses: Links and the facts in our starting list only; never product photos or descriptions

name: Facebook groups and pages, and messaging apps
uses: Nothing
